scripts.build: pnpm --filter @truefoundry/trueforge-core build && pnpm --filter @truefoundry/trueforge-sdk build && pnpm --filter @truefoundry/trueforge-ui build && pnpm --filter frontend build && pnpm --filter @truefoundry/trueforge build && pnpm --filter amanuensis build
scripts.build:dev-image: docker build -f Dockerfile.dev --build-arg BUILD_REF="$(git rev-parse HEAD)" -t aman:dev .
scripts.dev:no-watch: cross-env STANDALONE=false NODE_ENV=development pnpm --parallel --filter @truefoundry/trueforge --filter frontend dev:no-watch
scripts.dev:server:ui: pnpm --filter frontend build && pnpm --filter @truefoundry/trueforge build:frontend-assets && cross-env STANDALONE=false NODE_ENV=development pnpm --parallel --filter @truefoundry/trueforge-core --filter @truefoundry/trueforge dev
scripts.dev: cross-env STANDALONE=false NODE_ENV=development pnpm --parallel --filter @truefoundry/trueforge-core --filter @truefoundry/trueforge --filter frontend dev
scripts.nightona:sandbox:build: docker build --build-arg "TESSERACT_LANGS=eng deu fra spa ita por nld rus hin mar jpn chi_sim chi_tra kor ara" --build-arg NIGHTONA_BASE_IMAGE=ghcr.io/OWNER/nightona-sandbox-base:0.6.0 -t ghcr.io/OWNER/nightona-sandbox:0.6.0-slim-tf7 -f ops/nightona-sandbox/Dockerfile .
scripts.pack:dry: pnpm --filter @truefoundry/trueforge-core pack:dry && pnpm --filter @truefoundry/trueforge pack:dry && pnpm --filter amanuensis pack:dry
scripts.sandbox:slots:lock-python: cd ops/sandbox-slot/guest && uv pip compile requirements.in --universal --generate-hashes --python-version 3.12 -o requirements.txt
scripts.smoke: node scripts/require-smoke-env.mjs && docker compose up --build --wait && node -e "Promise.all([fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8791/healthz'), fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8791/')]).then(async ([health, ui]) => { if (!health.ok) throw new Error('healthz returned ' + health.status); const html = await ui.text(); if (!ui.ok || !html.includes('id=\"root\"')) throw new Error('UI did not return its app shell'); console.log('healthz and UI OK'); })"
scripts.standalone:dev:no-watch: cross-env STANDALONE=true NODE_ENV=development pnpm --parallel --filter @truefoundry/trueforge --filter frontend dev:no-watch
scripts.lint:installer: shellcheck installer/install.sh installer/doctor/aman installer/lib/*.sh installer/tests/*.sh installer/tests/lib/*.sh installer/tests/stubs/*
scripts.test:calendar-sidecar: npm --prefix ops/calendar-sidecar ci --ignore-scripts && npm --prefix ops/calendar-sidecar test
scripts.test: pnpm test:trueforge-core && pnpm test:trueforge-sdk && pnpm test:trueforge-ui && pnpm test:trueforge && pnpm test:frontend
scripts.verify: pnpm run test:private-data && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint:ci && pnpm run build && pnpm run test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @truefoundry/trueforge-sdk build && pnpm --filter @truefoundry/trueforge-ui build && pnpm --filter @truefoundry/trueforge-ui --filter @truefoundry/trueforge --filter frontend --parallel typecheck:only && pnpm --filter @truefoundry/trueforge-core --filter amanuensis --parallel typecheck
